Cold hosted path, actual local findings/dispute path, pr-arm, gate, gateway tooling, digest, coverage/changelog selection and base/PR heavy-tier semantics execute against exact released bytes; narrowing matcher rules still selects heavy tier.
All listed policy inventories and guard targets pass; underlying secret handoff/process isolation regression scenarios remain effective; Linux/macOS evidence is correctly platform-labelled.

Quiescence, unexpired freeze, pre-arm sync, package hash, independent bootstrap approval, owner recovery approval and post-merge sync are recorded. Rebase/reverted-base refusal scenarios rerun on exact cutover head.

description:
T9: one coherent BenchBox PR switches every inventory consumer to the reviewed trusted lock, isolated verified install and pinned workflow. Hosted review uses base lock; gate uses current develop lock in its own process. Migrate local launchers, pr-arm/pr-landing and remote callers, digest/coverage/changelog/heavy-tier consumers, gateway-host invocations, OMP bump/watch, archive/sparse lists and all other inventory rows. Remove old embedded engine/gate/obsolete entrypoints only when replacement is merged; the owner-approved verbatim matcher is the sole allowed embedded exception. No environment-flag dual implementation and one active production writer only. Preserve or explicitly import finding/dispute state; leave old export dirs inert, not executable.
Before arming: confirm bounded owner-approved freeze still valid, refresh source-sync ledger, verify exact artifact matches current parity, bind promotion evidence to actual PR head, complete owner activation/recovery approval, and drain verdict workflow (no in-progress runs). Check source-sync again after merge and re-dispatch held PRs only by approved procedure. If drift/freeze expiry occurs, stop, port changes and repeat parity/release/proof.
Complete policy-guard checklist: quality/comment-policy.json symbol/digest exceptions; quality/docs-reference-inventory.json; _project/inert-doc-readers.json; tests/unit/ledger_cutover_files.txt; preflight/scenario selection; Windows antipattern exclusions; mutation targets/copied inputs/test paths/runner; soundness/gate paths; archive lists; sparse checkouts; workflow filters. Run comment-policy, duplicate-check-delta, applicable inventory/freshness checks, consumer integration and required publication gates. Theseus owns its own docs/lint/security policy; preserve secret-handoff/process-isolation behaviour, not BenchBox exception machinery.
Update operating docs and changelog.d fragment, including evaluator-unavailable owner recovery and first-cutover revert to the named known-good commit. Keep required checks, App source binding, holds and thread requirements unchanged.
Guardrails: no bypass, fabricated status, stand-in substituting for missing evaluator, owner-secrets/settings action, activation or production publication without explicit owner authorization. A clean lock diff is never sufficient upstream review.
